description: A white plastic post with a round knob sits on a square base in front of you on a green sheet, with a large blue cushion propped behind it. The left hand slides in from the lower left to steady the base as the right hand reaches from the lower right to grasp the round knob; together they twist and lift, disassembling the post from the base so the right hand lowers the removed piece to the right side and both hands release.
